say:1:1620837001:1.text: As you move eastward, the forest begins to stir, as its inhabitants murmur softly about your presence.
say:1:1620837001:1.source_cn: 你们向着荧荧花指出的方向一路向前。窸窸窣窣的声音愈发频...
say:1:1620837001:1.male: As you move eastward, the forest begins to stir, as its inhabitants murmur softly about your presence.
say:1:1620837001:1.female: As you move eastward, the forest begins to stir, as its inhabitants murmur softly about your presence.

say:2:1620837002:1.text: The air is cold and oppressive at the heart of the forest. A foul stench rises from behind, accompanied by the sound of labored breathing.
say:2:1620837002:1.source_cn: 你们已经深入恶沼森林的腹地。周围的空气变得阴冷而沉重，...
say:2:1620837002:1.male: The air is cold and oppressive at the heart of the forest. A foul stench rises from behind, accompanied by the sound of labored breathing.
say:2:1620837002:1.female: The air is cold and oppressive at the heart of the forest. A foul stench rises from behind, accompanied by the sound of labored breathing.

say:11:1620837006:1.text: Th-This snow monster seems to mean no harm! Maybe it's friendly, just like that glimmerbloom from earlier?
say:11:1620837006:1.source_cn: 它、它似乎也没有攻击的意图。也许和刚刚的那只荧荧花一样...

say:13:1620837007:1.text: I know the drill. Time to use one of my skills to make it talk, right?
say:13:1620837007:1.source_cn: 我明白了，现在我们要用技能说服它，没错吧？

say:14:1620837008:1.source_cn: 既然如此……那么，我要使用技能“表演”！

say:16:1620837009:1.text: Wait a minute, Silven. Why would it want to see you perform?
say:16:1620837009:1.source_cn: 请等一下，休，你为什么要在这时候跳舞？

say:17:1620837010:1.text: Don't forget I'm now skilled in both dance and poetry! I'll charm the snow monster with my moves and turn it into our ally!
say:17:1620837010:1.source_cn: 想象一下，我现在是一位美丽的女性，而且是优秀的舞蹈诗人...

say:19:1620837011:0.text: This is a special, difficult action. A roll of 18 or above is required to use the "Perform" skill.
say:19:1620837011:0.source_cn: 行动回合开始。特殊困难行动，使用技能“表演”，需要掷出...

say:20:1620837012:0.text: As this is a special action, failing it will incur a penalty that causes unpredictable consequences.
say:20:1620837012:0.source_cn: 由于该行动属于特殊行动，拥有惩罚机制。若行动判定失败，...

say:22:1620837013:1.text: A penalty?! If you fail, will we be stuck here?
say:22:1620837013:1.source_cn: 欸，惩罚机制？！万一失败了，是不是就会丢失线索？

say:23:1620837014:1.text: Since we're a team, can I help Silven?
say:23:1620837014:1.source_cn: 那个……我们是队友，我可以帮助我的队友吗？应该可以用道...

say:25:1620837015:1.text: But Pippa, you only have your fists as a weapon right now...
say:25:1620837015:1.source_cn: 可是皮帕，现在你手里应该只有一根长棍作为武器……

say:26:1620837016:1.text: Maybe my fists will do the trick.
say:26:1620837016:1.source_cn: 那我就用这根长棍来为休提供协助。

say:27:1620837017:1.text: Are we even allowed to help each other? This isn't covered in the rules...
say:27:1620837017:1.source_cn: 这……规则里没提到过这一条，我们可以这样做吗？

choice_prompt:28:1620837017.text: Are we even allowed to help each other? This isn't covered in the rules...
choice_prompt:28:1620837017.source_cn: 这……规则里没提到过这一条，我们可以这样做吗？

say:30:1620837018:1.text: Collaboration wasn't in my original design, but... I like the idea!
say:30:1620837018:1.source_cn: 我的设计里的确没有这种操作，但不得不说，这想法……很有意思！

say:31:1620837019:1.text: It's a green light from me—Pippa can assist Silven!
say:31:1620837019:1.source_cn: 我同意了，她可以提供协助！

choice_prompt:32:1620837019.text: It's a green light from me—Pippa can assist Silven!
choice_prompt:32:1620837019.source_cn: 我同意了，她可以提供协助！

say:33:1620837020:1.text: As a professional game master, I'll improvise!
say:33:1620837020:1.source_cn: 这就要表现我身为主持人的专业素质了——即兴发挥！

say:35:1620837022:1.text: A roll of 14 or above is required for the Berserker to assist the Dancing Poet.
say:35:1620837022:1.source_cn: 狂战士使用长棍武器为舞蹈诗人提供协助，需要掷出14点，...

narration:38:1620837024:1.text: Pippa rolled a 16. The action is successful.
narration:38:1620837024:1.source_cn: 投掷完毕，点数为16点。行动判定成功<key:dial...

say:40:1620837025:1.text: The Berserker drums the ground, creating an enchanting beat. Then, the Dancing Poet glides forward... and performs a mesmerizing dance!
say:40:1620837025:1.source_cn: 狂战士将棍子立在雪怪面前。舞蹈诗人缓步上前，绕着这根棍...

say:44:1620837027:1.text: We've got this in the bag for sure!

say:46:1620837028:1.text: Creating a rhythm by drumming the ground... How creative!

say:48:1620837029:1.text: The snow monster has never seen such a passionate dance! Yet, the world that nurtures such vibrancy is ravaged by the Hypogean...
say:48:1620837029:1.source_cn: 一只居住在恶沼森林中的雪怪，从未见过如此热情奔放、富有...

say:49:1620837030:1.text: Moved to tears, the snow monster decides to become your ally!
say:49:1620837030:1.source_cn: 雪怪流下了悔恨不已的泪水！在舞蹈的感化下，它决定加入队...
say:49:1620837030:1.male: Moved to tears, the snow monster decides to become your ally!
say:49:1620837030:1.female: Moved to tears, the snow monster decides to become your ally!

say:50:1620837031:1.text: The snow monster gestures toward the <style="highlight">southwest</style>, where the Hypogean's lair lies.

say:52:1620837032:1.text: We did it! Our approach was unconventional, but that doesn't matter...
say:52:1620837032:1.source_cn: 真的成功了！虽然方法有点奇怪……

say:53:1620837033:1.text: I never imagined we could combine our skills like this. This game just keeps getting better!
say:53:1620837033:1.source_cn: 我之前从没想过将大家的技能搭配起来使用。看来这个游戏比...

say:54:1620837034:1.text: I thought you'd prefer games with fixed rules, Cassadee.
say:54:1620837034:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，我还以为你会更喜欢那种规则固定的游戏呢。

say:55:1620837035:1.text: Um, rules do matter to me, but since this is a game, I guess I can loosen up a little.
say:55:1620837035:1.source_cn: 唔，对我来说规则的确很重要，但既然只是游戏，适当放松一...

say:56:1620837036:1.text: Also, I find this game really inspiring. If skills can be combined here, maybe the same could work for spells in real life...
say:56:1620837036:1.source_cn: 而且我认为这种游戏对魔法学习也有一定的帮助。两种看似完...

say:57:1620837037:1.text: *Cough* Let's get back to the game. Now that we can combine skills, could there have been an even better way to recruit the snow monster?
say:57:1620837037:1.source_cn: 咳，还是说回这次的游戏吧。既然技能可以搭配使用，没准还...

say:58:1620837038:1.text: Suppose I could've used "Persuade" together with Pippa's "Intimidate"... would the effect be twice as strong?
say:58:1620837038:1.source_cn: 比如，用皮帕的“威吓”配合我的“说服”……也许能让话术...

say:59:1620837039:1.text: Or we could've started with my "Mystery" to subdue the snow monster first... though this is starting to sound more like coercion than persuasion.
say:59:1620837039:1.source_cn: 也可以先用我的“奥秘”通过魔法将对方打服……不对，这已...

say:60:1620837040:1.text: I wish we could try every combination!
say:60:1620837040:1.source_cn: 唉……感觉每种组合都好有意思，要是能都尝试一遍就好了。

say:61:1620837041:1.text: Too bad we can't do it all over again after we convince this ghost to move on...
say:61:1620837041:1.source_cn: 可惜这个游戏只能玩一次，等驱散了吟游诗人的恶灵，就没法...

say:66:1620837043:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Let's head <style="highlight">southwest</style> and confront the Hypogean!
say:66:1620837043:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Let's head <style="highlight">southwest</style> and confront the Hypogean!
say:66:1620837043:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s right. Let's head <style="highlight">southwest</style> and confront the Hypogean!

choice:64:0:1.source_cn: 先好好体验这次游戏吧

choice:32:0:1.male: How do we determine the outcome?
choice:32:0:1.female: How do we determine the outcome?

say:68:1620837021:1.text: It's called improvisation, a crucial skill for a professional game master.
say:68:1620837021:1.source_cn: 真是——失礼！不要质疑专业的主持人，请将这种行为称为“...

choice:32:1:2.text: So, you'll just make things up?
choice:32:1:2.male: So, you'll just make things up?
